title: Playground 1: First Days in Taiwan
subtitle: Essential survival conversations for your arrival.

dialogue.speaker: 司機
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, yào qù nǎlǐ?
dialogue.en: Hello, where are you going?

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù Xīnzhú Kēxué Yuánqū.
dialogue.en: I want to go to Hsinchu Science Park.

dialogue.speaker: 司機
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, dàgài yào yīgè xiǎoshí.
dialogue.en: Okay, it will take about an hour.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn duōshǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how much is it?

dialogue.speaker: 房東
dialogue.zh: 你好，這是你的房間鑰匙。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, zhè shì nǐ de fángjiān yàoshi.
dialogue.en: Hello, here is your room key.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問網路密碼是什麼？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè. Qǐngwèn wǎnglù mìmǎ shì shénme?
dialogue.en: Thank you. What is the Wi-Fi password?

dialogue.speaker: 房東
dialogue.pinyin: Mìmǎ zài zhuōzi shàng.
dialogue.en: The password is on the table.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Fángzū shénme shíhòu jiāo?
dialogue.en: When is rent due?

title: Playground 2: TSMC/Micron Office Basics
subtitle: Meeting colleagues and getting set up.

dialogue.speaker: 主管
dialogue.pinyin: Huānyíng jiārù wǒmen de tuánduì!
dialogue.en: Welcome to our team!

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 謝謝主管。很高興認識大家。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxiè zhǔguǎn. Hěn gāoxìng rènshì dàjiā.
dialogue.en: Thank you manager. Nice to meet everyone.

dialogue.speaker: 主管
dialogue.zh: 這是你的辦公桌和電腦。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de bàngōngzhuō hé diànnǎo.
dialogue.en: This is your desk and computer.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 如果有問題，我可以問誰？
dialogue.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu wèntí, wǒ kěyǐ wèn shéi?
dialogue.en: If I have questions, who can I ask?

dialogue.speaker: 同事
dialogue.zh: 進無塵室前要穿無塵衣。
dialogue.pinyin: Jìn wúchénshì qián yào chuān wúchényī.
dialogue.en: Before entering the cleanroom, you must wear a cleanroom suit.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wúchényī zài nǎlǐ?
dialogue.en: Okay, where are the cleanroom suits?

dialogue.speaker: 同事
dialogue.zh: 在前面的櫃子裡。手機不能帶進去。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài qiánmiàn de guìzi lǐ. Shǒujī bùnéng dài jìnqù.
dialogue.en: In the cabinet ahead. You cannot bring your phone inside.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 我明白了，我把手機放在外面。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ míngbái le, wǒ bǎ shǒujī fàng zài wàimiàn.
dialogue.en: I understand, I will leave my phone outside.

title: Playground 3: Convenience Store & Food
subtitle: Getting through daily meals and errands.

dialogue.speaker: 店員
dialogue.pinyin: Zǎo ān, qǐngwèn yào diǎn shénme?
dialogue.en: Good morning, what would you like to order?

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 我要一個蛋餅和一杯豆漿。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yào yīgè dànbǐng hé yī bēi dòujiāng.
dialogue.en: I want an egg pancake and a cup of soy milk.

dialogue.speaker: 店員
dialogue.pinyin: Nèiyòng háishì wàidài?
dialogue.en: For here or to go?

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Wàidài, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: To go, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 店員
dialogue.pinyin: Xūyào wéibō ma?
dialogue.en: Do you need this microwaved?

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Bùyòng, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: No need, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: 店員
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu zàijù ma? Yàobùyào fāpiào?
dialogue.en: Do you have a digital carrier? Do you want the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Fāpiào yìn chūlái, xièxiè.
dialogue.en: Print the receipt, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 主管
dialogue.zh: 大家早，請報告今天的進度。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàjiā zǎo, qǐng bàogào jīntiān de jìndù.
dialogue.en: Good morning everyone, please report todays progress.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 昨天發現了一個defect，已經修好了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zuótiān fāxiàn le yīgè defect, yǐjīng xiū hǎo le.
dialogue.en: I found a defect yesterday, it has been fixed.

dialogue.speaker: 主管
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Jīntiān de schedule shì shénme?
dialogue.en: Good. What is the schedule for today?

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ huì cèshì xīn de shèbèi.
dialogue.en: I will test the new equipment.

lessons.title: Asking for Help from a Colleague

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這個系統要怎麼用？
dialogue.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, zhège xìtǒng yào zěnme yòng?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how do I use this system?

dialogue.speaker: 同事
dialogue.zh: 你先登入，然後點這個按鈕。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ xiān dēngrù, ránhòu diǎn zhège ànniǔ.
dialogue.en: First you log in, then click this button.

dialogue.speaker: 你
dialogue.zh: 出現錯誤訊息了，怎麼辦？
dialogue.pinyin: Chūxiàn cuòwù xùnxí le, zěnme bàn?
dialogue.en: An error message appeared, what should I do?

dialogue.speaker: 同事
dialogue.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒ lái bāng nǐ kànkàn.
dialogue.en: No worries, let me take a look for you.
